title: KCRO: Kubernetes Cybersecurity Research Ontology
description: An OWL 2 DL ontology of Kubernetes security misconfigurations, grounded in gUFO, with a knowledge graph instantiated from the KubeObjects corpus and a deterministic mapping pipeline. Version 0.5.0 adds custom resources, GitOps delivery kinds and instance-level provenance, and is validated on three further corpora.
